thread:
carla_support: FYI — customer Ops (acct 8732) reporting burst of 502/504s and timeouts to hosted inference in us-east-2 over last ~20m. They see auth errors + spikes in retries. https://app.metrics/redwood/inst/8732 (chart)
ben_sre: tagging SRE. Can you paste a minimal repro (curl) and any auth headers? we need request ids
carla_support: customer provided this curl and response chunk:
```
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-live-xxxx' -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
> HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
< x-request-id: r-20260317-001
< via: 1.1 edge-gw
{ "error":"upstream timeout" }
```
carla_support: they also said token exchange failures intermittently, looks like ~20% of requests get a 401 then retry and eventually 502s
tim_netops: I'm seeing egress error counters for us-east-2 edge -> transit-provider-3. Short bursts of packet drops and TCP retransmits starting at 4329876400
maya_infra: deploy-bot shows no recent deploys for the model or gateway at that ts. deploy-bot: deployment check OK (last deploy 4329800000)
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: no new gateway config changes in last 48h
ben_sre: ok, likely network. tim, can you grab `tcpdump` / one-line pcap snippet from an affected edge host and any BGP neighbor logs? If provider is flapping we need to escalate.
tim_netops: attaching snip (abbreviated):
```
15:12:34.123 IP edge-us-east2-01 > transit-3: Flags [P.], seq 1234 ack 5678, win 64240
15:12:34.456 IP edge-us-east2-01 > transit-3: retransmission, seq 1234
15:12:34.789 IP edge-us-east2-01 > transit-3: retransmission, seq 1234
```

tim_netops: BGP logs show neighbor ASN 64512 withdraws for a subset of prefixes around 15:12:30, then re-announces 15:14:10. This aligns with spike window
ben_sre: That would explain transient egress blackholing. What's surprising is auth failures — might be timeouts happening inside our auth service while underlying egress is flapping causing upstream token validation to fail
alice_cs: Customer says they also saw a spike in billed tokens because they retried many requests client-side. They want a billing credit and summary of the root cause
carla_support: opened support ticket #SUP-17345 and included logs + request ids. Customer asked for ETA on fix
ben_sre: immediate mitigation: add a regional fallback route to transit-provider-2 for us-east-2 edge so requests can failover while provider-3 stabilizes. Tim, can you push a temporary route policy? also enable graceful retry-backoff on the API gateway for 502/504s for 60s
tim_netops: creating temporary local route-map to prefer transit-2 for affected prefixes. Pushing in 60s. Also raised provider ticket with ASN 64512 NOC
tim_netops: provider acked — investigating 'egress interface flaps' on their side. They provided incident ref TP-8891
maya_infra: enabling per-route circuit-breaker in gateway config and increasing KV-cache TTL to reduce auth calls. Patch pushed to edge config (no deploy required) — config reload succeeded
ben_sre: can we confirm error rate drop after the route change? need graphs
maya_infra: error-rate graph: https://app.metrics/redwood/inst/8732/errors?from=4329876300&to=4329877000 — error rate drops ~75% after 15:15:10
carla_support: shared that with the customer. They're still asking for detailed RCA and billing adjustment
alice_cs: I'll draft the customer note. Action items: (1) confirm provider root cause (tim), (2) collect request ids/trace spans for 15:10-15:20 window (carla & maya), (3) propose billing credit calculation (alice)
ben_sre: agree. Also add a follow-up to run a targeted failover rehearse for provider flaps in us-east-2 so we don't rely on manual route changes next time
tim_netops: provider said they'll post a full incident update by EOD. I'll include BGP RIB dumps and interface counters
carla_support: note — request ids to hand to customer: r-20260317-001 r-20260317-117 r-20260317-332 (sampled)
customer_ops: thanks — appreciate the quick rollback. Please confirm when your routing change is permanent or provider fixes their peer
ben_sre: filing incident ticket INC-2026-0317 with timeline, mitigations, and action items. Assigning to tim_netops for provider follow-up and to maya_infra for retry/circuit-breaker hardening
alice_cs: will follow up with customer about billing and share the draft RCA when ready
carla_support: closing thread for now — will reopen if customer sees additional errors. :white_check_mark:
